Lets the IOB-Action viewer set its own temp targets and short value leases. Everything is off by default.
Master switch. Off rejects every change; the status stays readable.
Allows SET and CANCEL of the viewer\'s own temp targets. Only with the channel on.
Allows SET and CLEAR of iobTH as a time limited lease. The base setting is never changed.
Allows SET and CLEAR of existing automation states, only with their own values, time limited.
Allows SET and CLEAR of the SMB delivery ratio as a time limited lease. The base setting is never changed.
Weights lease (acce, brake, pp, dura, range)
Allows SET and CLEAR of autoISF weights as a time limited lease. Only the named weights are changed.
The channel only checks commands and never changes anything. Works on all capabilities.
Creates a new secret and shows it once. Enter it in the viewer. A new secret replaces the old one.
Reads the signing digest of the installed IOB-Action viewer and makes it the only trusted caller.

string.name: lcc_trusted_message
string.comment: %1$s=start of the SHA-256 digest of the viewer signature, e.g. 3f2a9c0b1d4e5f60

resources.string: Digest: %1$s…\nRun this again when the viewer is signed with another key.
The IOB-Action viewer is not installed or its signature cannot be read.

string.name: lcc_status_summary
string.comment: %1$s=secret state (present/missing), %2$s=trusted signer state (set/empty), %3$d=count of rejected unknown callers

string.name: autoisf_live_no_effect_while_off
string.comment: %1$s=title of a switch. Example: No effect while Enable AutoISF is off

resources.string: autoISF does not change ISF: min and max are both 1

string.name: autoisf_live_range_stronger
string.comment: %1$.2f=factor. Example: autoISF can make ISF up to 2.00 times stronger, never weaker

resources.string: autoISF can make ISF up to %1$.2f times stronger, never weaker

string.name: autoisf_live_range_weaker
string.comment: %1$.2f=factor. Example: autoISF can make ISF up to 1.43 times weaker, never stronger

resources.string: autoISF can make ISF up to %1$.2f times weaker, never stronger

string.name: autoisf_live_range_both
string.comment: %1$.2f=factor stronger, %2$.2f=factor weaker. Example: autoISF can make ISF up to 2.00 times stronger or 1.43 times weaker

resources.string: autoISF can make ISF up to %1$.2f times stronger or %2$.2f times weaker

string.name: autoisf_live_iob_th_off
string.comment: %1$d=percent. Example: Off: iobTH does nothing at 100 %

string.name: autoisf_live_iob_th
string.comment: %1$s=threshold with unit, %2$d=percent, %3$s=max IOB with unit. Example: 3.00 U (30 % of max IOB 10.00 U). Profile % and sensitivity scale it.

resources.string: %1$s (%2$d %% of max IOB %3$s). Profile %% and sensitivity scale it.

string.name: autoisf_live_smb_ramp_off
string.comment: %1$.2f=ratio. Example: Ramp off: every SMB uses the fixed ratio 0.50

resources.string: Ramp off: every SMB uses the fixed ratio %1$.2f

string.name: autoisf_live_smb_ramp
string.comment: %1$.2f=ratio at target, %2$.2f=ratio at the top, %3$s=glucose range with unit. Example: Ramp: 0.50 at target, rising to 0.80 at target + 30 mg/dl

resources.string: Ramp: %1$.2f at target, rising to %2$.2f at target + %3$s
Not used: the ramp is off (BG range 0)
Not used while the ramp is on

string.name: autoisf_live_smb_full_loop_floor
string.comment: %1$s=glucose with unit. Example: With the ramp on, only used at even targets below 100 mg/dl, as the lowest ratio

resources.string: With the ramp on, only used at even targets below %1$s, as the lowest ratio
